item.tib: dbal phur gsang ba yang snying dbal nag khro rgyud kyi bzlog gzhung
item.coloph: ces dbal phur khro rgyud kyi bzlog (zlog) gzhung rma pom ra'i thugs ka nas/ (zlog) gzhung rma pom ra'i thugs ka nas/ kho bo dbra khyung pa g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gsang mtshan stag chung dbal 'bar stag slag can gyis rnyed pa/ khyung nag pho brang du gtan la phab pa'o//
